title: 鑽孔岩心記錄與岩體分類

summaryEn: Study topic: Core logging and rock-mass classification. Planned coverage includes geological risks, excavation support, waterproofing and deformation monitoring. Roadmap entry: step-by-step lessons and project details await editorial review; general references provide category context.
